svg.title: Spectre Brands — VCR Slot
svg.desc: A front-loading VCR fascia: cassette half-inserted in the flap, a ghost slipping out beside it, teal counter display, transport buttons and wide hi-fi lettering. All lettering outlined to paths; no fonts, raster or blur filters.
